dedupe_keys.name: nevada solar one measurement processing routines

description: The National Laboratory of the Rockies maintains the archived NREL processing routines for Nevada Solar One measurements. The repository contains mast, structural-load and lidar processing stages, synchronisation checks and publication helpers. Inspected load-processing code calculates corrected bending moments, trough angles and load coefficients, then produces one-minute summaries alongside higher-frequency observations. Python source is free under BSD-3-Clause. The README identifies the October 2021 to June 2023 measurement campaign; other applications require compatible instruments and calibration inputs. Processed loads can support structural and performance simulations associated with model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that the repository is archived and its short README does not provide a complete turnkey workflow. Local paths, instrument corrections and intermediate formats require review before reuse. The source was inspected but no measurements were processed or software executed.
